good: You have a local clip or image rather than a social link.
You want to choose the output language.
consider: You need predictable free quotas: the homepage and pricing page conflict.
You need a detailed shot-by-shot dialogue workflow.

faq.a: The homepage advertises free access without signup, but its pricing page lists paid plans. The free quota is unclear; check the current interface before committing.

faq.q: Which video files can I upload?
faq.a: The visible upload form lists MP4, WebM and MOV, up to 50 MB. Other formats mentioned elsewhere are not confirmed by that form.

faq.q: Can I use an image instead of a video?
faq.a: Yes. There is a separate Image tab; the site lists an image limit of 10 MB.

faq.q: Is this the same as VideoToPrompt.app?
faq.a: No. This listing covers videotoprompt.com. The .app domain has its own interface, plans and single-scene/multi-scene modes.

faq.q: Does it recover the exact original prompt?
faq.a: It creates a new description from the reference. Treat the result as a starting point for a similar shot, not proof of the original prompt.
